sections_reviewed: Section III-B network description (PDF pp. 5–8): PSPNet semantics, target-user location, feature selection and task heads
Section IV-A (pp. 9–10): CARLA/SUMO and synchronized Wireless InSite labels
title: Environment Semantics Aided Wireless Communications: A Case Study of mmWave Beam Prediction and Blockage Prediction
summary: Pixelwise environment semantics retain object classes, shapes and layout; target-user location disambiguates the client. Selected semantic maps plus auxiliary location train beam/blockage decision heads. CARLA/SUMO and Wireless InSite synchronize images and 28-GHz OFDM channels.
limits: Scene semantics for wireless are already studied. This is a synthetic street task, not DINOv3, packet-service calibration or a demonstrated novel warehouse representation. Do not use its model-selection description as permission to tune on our held-out test sites.
